venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Sunday 10/11.** Close Company Atlanta is closed on Sundays; no EON report is submitted. Dark day, not an outstanding report.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 10/11 (MOD & Chef KE DJ).** Net sales $1,827 vs target $1,739 (+5.1%). Food $163. 66 guests, ~$28 check avg. Comps $46.60 (2.5%). Started easy, ended with several good-sized parties; birthday group from Halls Chophouse, industry night with folks from Pelayo and Street Car. Incident: a guest fell on the steps (Kala has the details). 86: Guinness draft, Taco Tuesday; low acid celery cordial.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 10/11 (AM MOD & Chef Carey; PM Maggie H).** Net sales $8,628.98 vs target $10,528 (-18.0%); no events. DC/AM $1,115.68, D&C PM $7,489.61. Food $2,033.70. 193 guests (Tock). Comps $439.99. Only two servers all day; rough first few hours, smoother as the night went. Kitchen 911: scallop, burger meat ground, agnolotti formed, cherry vermouth reduction.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 10/11 (MOD & Chef: Will).** Net sales $5,119 vs target $4,399 (+16.4%). Food $535, beverage $4,584. 141 guests, $36 check avg. Comps $139.08 (about half investor/member discount). Heavy rain inhibited traffic; guests waitlisted multiple places and camped. Hit capacity around 8pm; max wait ~20 min. 4 solos, 2 large parties, 4 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Paper Wasp, Rosalie, Shinebox Long Time Caller. No-show: Carrie Grant for 2 at 6:30. Breakage: 1 DOF, 1 sidecar.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: No Sunday 10/11 report submitted as of Oct 12 run; will retry next pass.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 10/11 (MOD Marcus).** Net sales incl. events $3,649.76 vs target $2,879 (+26.8%). Marquee bar sales $4,014.72; food $400. 85 guests (59 walk-in, 26 reso), GCA $42.94. Comps $106.44. Nice pop at opening, another ~6pm and ~9:15. Barback training (Alhenn), Owen's first Marquee shift. Erin (hosting Samsung event Tuesday) toured and had a comped drink. Maintenance: carbonation/water filtration (AC Bev to call), ADA bathroom lock broken (replacement Tuesday), curtain rail.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Showers in the morning, turned beautiful
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 10/11 (AM Sam & Marcus; PM Justin & Shannon).** Net sales $12,019 vs target $8,020 (+49.9%). Municipal Bar AM $3,818, PM $5,781; Sun Club $627; Hot Eye $1,766. Food $4,513. 327 guests (167 AM + 160 PM, OpenTable). Comps $161. Busy happy hour, slow before 10am; Hot Eye packed by the 9pm bar crawl; solid industry push at midnight. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sunday 10/11 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net sales $8,295 vs target $8,000 (+3.7%). Food $1,269. 196 guests, $42 check avg. Comps ~$535 (~$150 shifties, ~$100 DNL/SND, rest community discounts). Post-Hawks-game crowd; standing room held 30-45 min for a big walk-in party that never showed. Maintenance: need storage once glycol machine is gone or installed.
